mapper.select: select Sum((CUO_Money * IFNUll(CUO_BL,100) / 100 )) from BG_ConUnitOrder where State = 7 and CUO_ConId = #{conId} and (CUO_bl != 0 or CUO_bl is null) and id not in (select VO_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)

select * from ( select cuo.id as id, cuo.CUO_Code as code, '单位指令单' as type, cuo.CUO_PId as pId, cuo.CUO_ConId as conId, ifnull((IFNUll(cuo.CUO_BL,100) - (select ifnull(sum(co_glbl),0) from bg_contactorder where co_glid = cuo.id and state =7)),100) as BL, cuo.CUO_Money as Money, cuo.final_confirm_money as finalConfirmMoney from BG_ConUnitOrder cuo where cuo.State = 7 and (cuo.CUO_bl != 0 or cuo.CUO_bl is null) and cuo.CUO_ConId = #{request.conId} and cuo.id not in (select vo_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7) ) t where t.BL > 0

select cuo.id as id, cuo.CUO_Code as code, '单位指令单' as type, cuo.CUO_PId as pId, pp.P_Name as pName, cuo.CUO_ConId as conId, cc.Con_Name as conName, (100 - IFNUll(cuo.CUO_BL,100)) as BL, cuo.CUO_Money as Money, IFNUll(cuo.CUO_BL,100) as TrueBL, (cuo.CUO_Money * IFNUll(cuo.CUO_BL,100) / 100 ) as TrueMoney from BG_ConUnitOrder cuo left join Con_Contract cc on cc.Con_Id = cuo.Con_Id left join pre_project pp on pp.P_ID = cuo.P_Id where cuo.State = 7 and (cuo.CUO_bl != 0 or cuo.CUO_bl is null) and cuo.id not in (select VO_GLID from BG_VisaOrder where state = 7)
and INSTR(cuo.CUO_Code,#{request.code})
and INSTR(cc.con_name,#{request.conName})
and likePname(#{request.pName},pp.P_Id)=true
and INSTR(pp.p_name,#{request.pName})
